guarantees.claim: If flush_st is not one of FlushIdle, FlushPacker, FlushFifo, or FlushClear, flush_st_d is forced to FlushIdle.
guarantees.cond: when flush_st is an invalid encoding

guarantees.claim: msgfifo_flush_done is driven to 1 only when flush_st is FlushFifo and fifo_empty_o is true; otherwise it is 0 (due to default assignment).
Unless a specific branch overrides, flush_st_d is assigned the current value of flush_st.
In FlushClear state, flush_st_d transitions to FlushIdle only when prim_mubi_pkg::mubi4_test_true_strict(clear_i) is true; otherwise it remains FlushClear.

assumptions.claim: The external initiator must eventually assert process_i while flush_st is FlushIdle to start the flush sequence.
assumptions.risk: Deadlock: the FSM remains in FlushIdle forever, no flush possible.

assumptions.claim: The packer module must eventually assert packer_flush_done when the FSM is in FlushPacker.
assumptions.risk: Deadlock: FSM hangs in FlushPacker, blocking further flush progress.

assumptions.claim: The FIFO must eventually assert fifo_empty_o when the FSM is in FlushFifo.
assumptions.risk: Deadlock: FSM hangs in FlushFifo, blocking flush completion.

assumptions.claim: The external clear controller must eventually set clear_i to a mubi4 TRUE value when the FSM is in FlushClear to allow return to idle.
assumptions.risk: Deadlock: FSM remains in FlushClear, preventing any future flush sequences.

uncertain_points.claim: The FSM exits FlushClear solely on clear_i being mubi4 TRUE, but does not enforce that the actual clearing hardware has completed wiping secret data. A premature TRUE could allow residual secrets.
uncertain_points.cond: flush_st == FlushClear and clear_i evaluated as TRUE
uncertain_points.risk: Confidential key/material residues may persist after flush-complete if clear_i is asserted too early.

uncertain_points.claim: process_i is sampled without handshake; if it is asserted while packer is not ready, the FSM moves to FlushPacker and may hang if packer_flush_done never arrives.
uncertain_points.risk: Potential hang: FSM stuck in FlushPacker if packer cannot complete its flush.

uncertain_points.claim: msgfifo_flush_done is a combinatorial pulse lasting only the cycle where fifo_empty_o is true and flush_st is FlushFifo; a downstream consumer must capture it in that exact cycle.
uncertain_points.risk: Loss of flush-done notification if the consumer does not grab the signal in the correct cycle (e.g., due to clock domain crossing).
